coverage: Partial verified selection: 60 sessions from 19 programmes across six venues, including Central Library, Walt Disney Concert Hall, The Broad, Getty Center, REDCAT and SCI-Arc. 36 repeated library sessions are not distinct programmes. Added architecture lectures, symposium, book launch, performance programmes and a festival. Seven local dates reviewed; full 30-day pagination, neighbourhood variety and social coverage remain incomplete. Hammer candidates await independent venue coordinates.
